t: You're looking at a memorial to Margaret McMillan, outside the Rachel McMillan Nursery School in Greenwich. McMillan was a nursery school pioneer who worked in deprived districts of London, notably Deptford, and in Bradford. She lobbied for the 1906 Provision of School Meals Act and pioneered a play-centred approach to teaching small children. The memorial was designed by Sir Herbert Baker, the architect best known for his work in South Africa.
